tools.name: list_casona_properties
tools.description: List the two Casona boutique hotels in Cartagena and their official direct-booking engine URLs. No availability is checked and no reservation is made.

tools.name: search_casona_room_quotes
tools.description: Check live SiteMinder room availability and full-stay room rates in COP excluding 19% Colombian VAT for either or both Casona hotels. Also returns the tax-inclusive amount for verification, plus room/rate names and date-prefilled direct-booking links. No booking is created; guest must confirm rates
